request: Was habe ich letzten Monat pro Kategorie ausgegeben?

plan.title: Ausgaben letzten Monat nach Kategorie
plan.question: Spending per category from 2025-11-01 to 2025-11-30, one row per category, ordered by the figure, columns topic and total_eur.

sql:
SELECT category AS topic, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0 AND category IN ('Supermarket', 'Bakery')
  AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30'
GROUP BY topic
ORDER BY total_eur DESC

eine Zahl je Kategorie, also Balken
die Spalten sind topic und total_eur
reasoning_code:
the shape is bar, so the mark is barY
the columns are topic and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
names on x on a band scale, no label dropped, tilted once they are many or long
a bar rests on zero, so its euro axis is the bare scaleLinear factory

request: Which shops took the most of my money in the last 90 days?

plan.title: Biggest merchants of the last 90 days
plan.question: The ten merchants with the most spending from 2025-10-02 to 2025-12-31, named by their enriched title, one row per merchant, ordered by the figure, columns merchant and total_eur.

sql:
SELECT coalesce(title, counterparty, description) AS merchant, ROUND(-SUM(amount_cents) / 100, 2) AS total_eur

ORDER BY total_eur DESC

request: Zeig mir die letzten sechs Monate gestapelt nach Kategorie.

plan.title: Ausgaben der letzten sechs Monate nach Kategorie
plan.question: Spending per month and category from 2025-07-01 to 2025-12-31, one row per month and category, every category under its own name, columns month as 'YYYY-MM', topic and total_eur.

sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
       CASE WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%rewe%' THEN 'Supermarkt'
            WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%bvg%' THEN 'Verkehr'
            ELSE 'Sonstiges' END AS topic,
       ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur

WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on >= '2025-07-01'
GROUP BY month, topic
ORDER BY month, topic

gestapelte Balken, weil die Summe je Monat zaehlt

the columns are month, topic and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
topic is the series, so it is the z and the color channel and it needs a legend
a stack is taller than any single row, so the euro axis names no domain

request: Show what we spent at Kaufland, EDEKA and REWE per month since the summer.

plan.title: Three supermarkets since the summer
plan.question: Spending at Kaufland, EDEKA and REWE per month from 2025-06-01 to 2025-12-31, one row per month and shop, columns month as 'YYYY-MM', merchant and total_eur.

sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
       coalesce(title, counterparty, description) AS merchant,
       ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on >= '2025-06-01'
  AND (lower(description) LIKE '%kaufland%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%edeka%'
       OR lower(description) LIKE '%rewe%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%aldi%'
       OR lower(description) LIKE '%lidl%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%penny%'
       OR lower(description) LIKE '%netto%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%rossmann%'
       OR lower(description) LIKE '%dm%')
GROUP BY month, merchant
ORDER BY month, merchant
reasoning_plan:
the request is English, so language en
'since the summer' is 2025-06-01 to 2025-12-31
three shops over seven months are three series
I match every supermarket in the list to be safe
the columns are month, merchant and total_eur
reasoning_code:
the shape is line and these rows carry a series, so one lineY over all of them
the columns are month, merchant and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
merchant names the series, so it is the z and the color channel and it needs a legend
months on x with monthShort, euros on y over every figure in the rows, zero included
